answer: Let trust flow from honest seed nodes through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph, with each node’s contribution capped. A Sybil cluster whose external edge boundary is small relative to its volume has low conductance, so few walks enter it; its aggregate voting weight is therefore bounded by the seed mass reaching that cut and the per-node cap, not by the number of fabricated identities. Even nodes named nectar, copper, and shale gain no weight merely by attesting to one another.
